sentences.en: Ziri asked Rima if he could borrow her garden hose.
sentences.zh: 齐里向莉玛借花园软管。

sentences.en: This hose is junk. It kinks way too easily.
sentences.zh: 这条软管质量很差。它很容易打结。

sentences.en: Layla put the fire out with a garden hose.
sentences.zh: 莱拉用花园水管扑灭了火灾。

senses.zh: 连裤袜, 长筒袜, 短统袜 软管, 胶管, 水龙头
